data.name: Whey Protein Concentrate 80%
data.source_report: USDA AMS Dairy Market News, weekly whey narrative (report 1053)
data.excerpt: Regular WPC 80% is reported from $12 to $13.
data.interpretation: Market indication WPC80 $12.00-$13.00/lb (midpoint $12.50). This is a DMN narrative reading, a market indication before freight and conversion costs — not an executable quote or a transaction-weighted average.

data.name: Whey Protein Isolate
data.source_report: USDA AMS Dairy Market News, weekly whey narrative (report 1053)
data.excerpt: Whey protein isolate (WPI) continues to draw firm interest, with most prices ranging from the upper $13s to mid $14s and some resales topping $15.
data.interpretation: Market indication WPI $13.00-$14.00/lb (midpoint $13.50). This is a DMN narrative reading, a market indication before freight and conversion costs — not an executable quote or a transaction-weighted average.
